reference.title: Generalize agent hook lifecycle across 9 agents
reference.summary: Replaced the hardcoded per-event Claude Code shell hooks with a generalized ox agent hook <event> command that maps any coding agent's native lifecycle events onto canonical phases (start, compact, etc.). Added LifecycleEventMapper implementations for 9 agents — Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Kiro, Droid, Cline, Copilot, Amp, and OpenCode — and extracted HookInput/ReadHookInput into a reusable agentx package. A principal-engineer review during the session flagged three real bugs that would have shipped: fragmented pipe reads (switched to io.ReadAll), stdin passthrough silently dropping unknown fields (added RawBytes field), and leftover dead code from the hardcoded path. Also added belt-and-suspenders auto-recording where both prime and the hook handler start the recording, made idempotent so double-start is harmless.
key_actions: Implemented ox agent hook <event> with phase dispatch for start and compact
Added LifecycleEventMapper in agentx for 9 coding agents
Extracted HookInput and ReadHookInput into pkg/agentx/hook_input.go
Fixed fragmented-pipe-read bug by switching to io.ReadAll
Added RawBytes field so stdin passthrough preserves unknown JSON fields
Removed dead code from the pre-refactor hardcoded hook path
Made auto-recording idempotent across prime and hook-handler entry points
